statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
There is clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I49.5.
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The procedure is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197.
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure.
